Official @mlc-ai/web-llm version 0.2.88, Apache-2.0.
https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mlc-ai/web-llm/v/0.2.88
https://github.com/mlc-ai/web-llm
The unmodified distribution package/lib/index.js is stored as web-llm.mjs. Its npm package integrity was verified before extraction. This 6.8 MB optional runtime is dynamically imported after a person enables the browser selector. The app config pins model weights and the compiled WASM library to immutable public revisions in reader-device.js. GPU inference executes in this browser.
